timeline.summary: JNK India filed the Q4 FY26 monitoring agency report showing ₹281.43 Cr utilised from IPO proceeds.
JNK India Limited’s **Ashish Soni** scheduled a **Q4FY26 earnings conference call** with **Arvind Kamath, Anand Agarwal, Annie Varghese** on **May 21, 2026, at 12:00 IST** via virtual mode.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹338.44 Cr (+77.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹32.65 Cr.
JNK India reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹838.0 Cr (+68.0% YoY) and PAT of ₹64.8 Cr, with an order book of ₹1,961.4 Cr at 31 March 2026.
JNK India reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹344.6 Cr (+69.2% YoY) and guided for 25-30% revenue growth in FY27.
Dipak Kacharulal Bharuka, as Promoter of JNK India Limited, declared no encumbrance on shares held by promoters or persons acting in concert by March 31, 2026.

JNK India received a Large (₹300-600 Cr band) order from CC7 Emirates Engineering Solutions L.L.C., UAE on June 8, 2026 for an incinerator package for ADNOC's TA'ZIZ Salt Project, Abu Dhabi, to be delivered by December 2027.
On June 8, 2026, JNK India announced receiving a Large export order from CC7 Emirates Engineering Solutions for waste gas handling systems for the TA'ZIZ Salt Project in Abu Dhabi.
